comments.why: Describes solving a similar multithreading problem in a physics solver.
comments.text: From my understanding this talk describes how he implemented a solution for a similar problem [VIDEO] I'm saying if you're not writing multi-threaded code everyday, use a library. It can use atomics/locks but you shouldn't use it directly. If the library is designed well it'd be impossible to deadlock.
